purpose: Every limitation of this court, stated so its results are not read as stronger than their evidence.

limitations.limitation: All measurements are on synthetic carriers, not on any real survey source.
limitations.detail: Carriers are 587-byte SAV and 2117-byte DTA files with two numeric variables and four rows, written by pyreadstat's own writer and round-trip proved before use.
limitations.effect: C2 counts describe the code path's access SHAPE, which is a property of the code. They say nothing about how many opens a real multi-hundred-megabyte file would cause internally, and nothing about real source behaviour.
limitations.does_not_undermine: The enforcement demonstration. Abort-before-operation is a property of the guard, not of the file size.

limitations.limitation: The SRC27-shaped compatibility read was reached only by a disclosed in-memory allowlist injection.
limitations.detail: pre553_physical_decoder._compatibility_config admits an encoding override only when the source SHA-256 is in COMPATIBILITY_ALLOWLIST. No synthetic carrier can have a real source's SHA. So the unmodified fail-closed refusal was measured FIRST as its own probe (D2), and only then was the allowlist extended in memory, disclosed, and reverted.
limitations.effect: The compatibility access SHAPE is faithfully measured. The specific value a real SRC27 run would consume is not, and is not claimed.
limitations.precedent: C4C3's six disclosed harness injections, with unmodified fail-closed behaviour measured first and kept as its own probe.
limitations.verification: Allowlist restoration verified true after both injection probes.

limitations.limitation: Instrumentation is monkeypatch-based, not an in-process audit hook.
limitations.detail: Path.is_file, the decoder module's _sha, and the pyreadstat reader bindings are wrapped in Python. All patches are reverted on exit.
limitations.effect: Sufficient to count and to enforce at the declared layer. It is NOT a kernel-level or syscall-level audit, and does not claim to be.

limitations.limitation: The governed runtime was the surviving C4C3 environment, not a freshly built one.
limitations.detail: Used: /var/folders/.../T/opencode/c4c3-env with python 3.11.3, pyreadstat 1.3.6, pandas 2.3.3, pyarrow 25.0.1, numpy 2.4.6, pytest 9.1.1. Its 13-package seed digest reproduces the frozen 9cde8e5ab9abba46a9e98826100ed084a0943a77fee7bc232a3c7643334da2eb exactly, and narwhals 2.26.0 is present as the frozen record states.
limitations.effect: Results are qualified on the exact C4C3 runtime, which is the correct runtime for comparability.
limitations.r7_observation: This environment is the one the environment lock declared NOT durable in a per-session temporary directory. It survives and still verifies byte-for-byte against the frozen seed. Recorded as an OBSERVATION bearing on R7 remediation option (a) durable exact environment preservation. THIS COURT DOES NOT ADJUDICATE R7 and makes no R7 finding.

limitations.detail: pre553_route_b_production.py and pre553_carrier_execution.py were observed NOT to call decode_sav or decode_dta directly; they import PhysicalSourceIncidence and PhysicalCell types. The decode itself is invoked from ee_p2x_darwin_stage_backend.py:724 and fiabc_final_oracle_freeze_producers.py:1267.
limitations.effect: The court exercised the decoder entry points directly. It did NOT exercise the full producer/carrier consumer path, so per-source budgets are stated per DECODE rather than per full governed run.
limitations.consequence_for_policy: If a governed run performs multiple decode entries per source, the per_source_decode_entry_calls C3 maximum of 1 will stop it. That is the intended conservative behaviour, not a defect, but HQ should know the ceiling is expressed per decode entry.

limitations.limitation: Proposed maxima are policy, not derived quantities.
limitations.detail: Every c3_proposed_maxima value is a chosen ceiling supported by enforceability evidence. None is computed from a C2 measurement and none is presented as a C1 historical expectation.
limitations.effect: Adopting them is an HQ authority decision. This lane decided nothing.
limitations.narrower_than_needs_is_acceptable: If a future authorized real run needs more than a maximum allows, the run MUST STOP rather than silently widen authority.

limitations.limitation: No independent review of this court exists.
limitations.detail: Nothing produced here has been reviewed by any party other than this lane.
limitations.effect: Hostile independent review is mandatory before HQ removes R9 on the strength of any part of this.

claims_deliberately_not_made: That any OS-level file-open count was measured, bounded or made enforceable. Zero were visible; none is proposed.
That the reader-invocation ceiling IS the path-level-open account. It is an upper bound on logical accesses and is labelled as such.
That any synthetic measurement is evidence about a real survey file.
That any C2 or C3 value is a historical expected count.
That the hardened note's floor of one was promoted to a ceiling.
That a selected-column read or a header-prefix read occurs at the decoder layer. Neither does.
That byte counts are observable at this layer. They are not.
That PRQ-07's discharge closes R9 or authorizes source access.
That the producer/carrier consumer path was exercised.
That the proposed maxima are adopted, approved or authorized.
That this court adjudicated R7, notwithstanding the environment observation.
That any prior historical expectation, the HQ190-C diagnostic, or any historical warrant artifact was modified.

fabrication_guard.statement: Where the evidence was silent or the layer was unobservable, this court recorded silence or unobservability rather than a number.

verification_discipline.non_equality_law: No finding rests on null == null or absent-field equality. Every artifact identity resolves to a nonempty exact 40-hex blob or complete digest.
